name: Grupo Gigante, S. A. B. de C. V.
summary: Grupo Gigante, S. A. B. de C. V., together with its subsidiaries, operates convenience stores and restaurants in Mexico, Central America, and Chile. It also operates stationery stores; and office supplies stores, including furniture and electronic products. In addition, the company distributes and provides inventory management services for office products; sales prepared food; manages and operates parking lots parking lots; and sells merchandise, as well as engages in real estate activities. Grupo Gigante, S. A. B. de C. V. was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Mexico City, Mexico.
